REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL
Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of CCTV Surveillance System
Ref No: GEM/2024/B/SAMPLE-01

1.1 Scope of Work
The scope includes supply of 500 IP Cameras, 10 NVRs, and 5 years of onsite warranty. The bidder must ensure all equipment is IPv6 compliant.

4.2 Hosting Requirements
All data must be hosted within India. Use of foreign cloud providers for sensitive video data is strictly prohibited per MeitY guidelines.

Item Description | Qty | Specifications
Camera Type A | 200 | 4MP, IR 50m
Camera Type B | 300 | 8MP, PTZ
